hypotheses.title: Asymmetric Long-Tenor Option Skew Mean-Reversion (360d Put vs 270d Call)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Market makers chronically overcharge for 1-year catastrophe put protection (implied_volatility_put_360) relative to 9-month call optionality (implied_volatility_call_270). Shorting this excessive skew harvests an unexploited structural volatility risk premium with 15% turnover and zero platform decay lag.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if 360-day put skew accurately prices prolonged structural recessions.

hypotheses.title: Ultra Long-Tenor Option Skew Mean-Reversion (720d Put vs 360d Call)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Overpriced 2-year put implied volatility (implied_volatility_put_720) relative to 1-year call implied volatility (implied_volatility_call_360) reflects extreme institutional hedging demand. Mean-reverting this skew generates market-neutral returns with low portfolio correlation.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if 2-year put skew persists without mean-reverting.
